description: This file defines a Java interface 'ShareProductWritePlatformService' which declares methods for creating, updating, and managing share products and their dividends within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ShareProductWritePlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface for share product write operations, including creation, update, dividend management and approval.

methods.name: createShareProduct
methods.description: Creates a new share product based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing share product identified by productId with new data provided in the JSON command.

methods.name: createShareProductDividend
methods.description: Creates a dividend entry for a specified share product.

methods.name: approveShareProductDividend
methods.description: Approves a share product dividend payout identified by PayOutDetailId.

methods.name: deleteShareProductDividend
methods.description: Deletes a share product dividend payout identified by PayOutDetailId.
